queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'Foxit PDF Editor' AND publisher = 'Foxit Software Inc.';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'Foxit PDF Editor' AND publisher = 'Foxit Software Inc.' AND version_compare(version, '14.0.6.33584') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'foxit pdf editor.exe');
